articles.title: Rock Clouds Vanish Every Night on This Faraway Planet!
articles.summary: Imagine clouds made of rock! On planet WASP-94A b, morning skies are cloudy with magnesium silicate, but by evening they disappear. Scientists used the James Webb Space Telescope to watch this happen 700 light-years away.

articles.title: DNA Solves 250-Year Mystery of Vanished Crocodiles!
articles.summary: Saltwater crocodiles once lived on the Seychelles islands, but they disappeared 200 years ago. New DNA research shows they weren't a separate species—they were the westernmost population of the world's largest reptile, having drifted over 3,000 km across the ocean.

articles.title: Scientists Smash 30-Year Record for Superconductors at Normal Pressure!
articles.summary: A new material can conduct electricity with zero resistance at -122°C, the highest temperature ever at normal pressure. This beats a 30-year-old record and could lead to super-efficient power grids and faster electronics.
